name: Frost Shell
hint: Ice soaks hits and regrows. Keep firing!

name: Gravity Well
hint: Its pools drag you and your shots in. Steer clear and fire around them

name: Blade Carrier
hint: Each third of its HP releases blade divers. Move after every flash

name: Meteor Caller
hint: Stay out of the marked lanes. Meteors crush enemies too

name: Mirror Knight
hint: Its mirror bounces shots back. Fire while it's down

name: Phase Stalker
hint: Shots pass through it while faded. Hit it when solid

name: Puppeteer
hint: Hurls your foes at you. Kill it to cut the strings

name: Rock Hauler
hint: Kill it fast or it swings the rock at you. Cut the tether from the side

name: Shield Warden
hint: Shields its escorts. Take it out first

name: Sweeper
hint: Watch the aiming line, then get behind the sweep

name: Twin Sentinels
hint: Each rebuilds the other. Kill both within 3 seconds

name: Orbit Warden
hint: Drones block your shots. Fire through the gaps

name: Aegis
hint: Its shield sends every shot back. Aim for the open arc

name: Copy Robot
hint: It fires your own gun back at you

name: Flash Stopper
hint: Freezes your ship. Move to safety at the warning

name: Leaf Warden
hint: Leaves block your shots, then launch. Hit it after the launch

name: Mirage
hint: Only the real one casts a shadow
